summary: Frontend-only testing of Treesh M.A.D. Models tab new features: Model Comp Cards, Scout Filters, and new models.html block file format. Created 3 models via drawer, verified file format, filters, comp card modal UX, publish flow, edit/delete persistence and mobile viewport. All critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html is >3000 lines in a single HTML file (per app design). Not blocking but a long-term maintainability concern.

In openComp, copy-link toast text ('Share link copied. Publish the page so it opens.') is slightly different from the review request wording ('Share link copied…'). Both include 'Share link copied' prefix; keep consistent if desired.

The 'success-close-btn' data-testid is reused across many success modals (artist, model, lyrics, comp, delete). It works but makes selector targeting ambiguous; publish-success-modal container testid helps.
test_credentials: Mock GitHub token: 'testtoken'; API base https://music-catalog-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/api/mockgh (POST /reset works)
seed_data_creation: Created 3 models via UI in live mode: Ava Test (5'7, Main, Atlanta GA, Available, Runway/Editorial), Mia Test (5'10, Development/New Faces, New York NY, Limited, Commercial/Print), Zoe Test (6'1, Main, Los Angeles CA, Booked, Runway/Fitness). Published Zoe Test comp card to models/zoe-test.html.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) content/models.html uses <div class="model" data-model-id data-name data-model-sort="[data-model-id]" data-bg data-bg-pos="center top" ...> wrapping model__thumbnail, model__label, model__photos; newest-first ordering; edit/delete preserve neighbor blocks; (b) Filters mf-min/mf-max/mf-board/mf-city/mf-avail/mf-cat combine with search and show 'Showing X of Y models' via mf-count; mf-clear hidden when inactive; cities derived from data; height-min=5'10 correctly reduces 3->2 models; (c) Comp card modal: iframe srcdoc front has NAME/board·city/Height/Bust/Waist/Hips/Shoe/Dress/Hair/Eyes, back has Measurements in/cm and Booking (Agency/Email/Instagram/Portfolio/Based in/Availability) and footer treesh.app/models/<slug>; share-url shows https://treesh.app/models/<slug>; copy code and copy link toasts fire; print calls iframe print; publish in live mode writes models/<slug>.html containing '@page{size:5.5in 8.5in;margin:0}' and shows success modal with success-open-page-link to https://treesh.app/models/<slug>; Esc closes the modal; (d) settings-comp-dir-input default is 'models'; (e) at 390x844 no horizontal page overflow with filters visible.
